# Reference — our own design, for comparison

**These are copies.** The authoritative versions live in `aidanpscott/KOTOR_RPG_MAIN_WORK`, which the study agent cannot open. Placed here so batch 3's UTC comparison and later batches can run against a real spec rather than an inference.

**⚠ Do not edit these.** If something here looks wrong, say so in the batch report rather than correcting it — a correction made in a copy is lost.

**⚠ And a caution about the skill count.** `SKILLS-01` line 15 contains the *quoted text of a historical error* — `PT-865` records that the header once read "twenty-two skills" and was corrected. **The live count is 24.** Reading a quoted correction as a current claim is an easy mistake and this project has a name for it: a claim carries the warrant of its reading, not of its relay.
